thread:
Aisha Khan: Quick thread for Solaris (pilot). They signed up for 10 seats but billing shows 5. Customer worried we under-provisioned. Can someone confirm seat assignment before enablement? :thinking:
Tom Li: I pulled the intake form. Looks like they requested 10 in the sales notes but the provisioning script consumed the "seat_count" field as an integer string and defaulted to 5. Fixing now.
Nora Patel: Thanks Tom. Hold on the enablement invite until seats are confirmed. We should also clarify which org users need admin access. Solaris named 2 admins in the spreadsheet.
Sam Rivera: I'll hold the invite. Also flagged: customer asked about telemetry exports to Databridge EU. We need to confirm PII stripping and retention settings before sharing logs.
Aisha Khan: Good call. Can engineering provide the retention policy and an example sanitized payload we send? Solaris wants that for procurement.
Tom Li: From infra: default retention for pilot logs = 30 days, PII fields (email, phone, user_id) are redacted in export by default. Example sanitized payload attached below:
```
{
  "event": "inference_call",
  "model": "gptx-preview",
  "inputs": "[REDACTED]",
  "tokens": 120,
  "timestamp": "2025-07-14T15:12:03Z"
}
```
Nora Patel: I'll pass that to Solaris legal. Also proposing a 5-question post-enablement micro-survey to catch blockers early. Suggest we keep one open text field for "integration blocker".
Sam Rivera: Love the micro-survey. Can we run it immediately after the enablement with an optional follow-up call if they select "integration blocker"? That will reduce renewal friction.
Aisha Khan: Yes. Make the follow-up opt-in. Also, add a renewal-risk tag on the pilot board if they report an "integration blocker" or "SSO issues". We have a 90-day pilot and need to track risk signals.
pilot-bot: Reminder: Solaris enablement scheduled by Nora Patel on 2025-07-16T17:00:00Z. Use /pilot-survey to attach the post-session questions.
Tom Li: Seat count fixed to 10; provisioning re-run completed. I bumped their quota and added the two admins.
Nora Patel: Sent updated invite for 2025-07-16 10am PT (45m). Included runbook and sample prompts. Link to runbook: https://redwood.app/drive/pilots/solaris/runbook.pdf
Sam Rivera: Hooked the post-enablement form to /pilot-survey. Survey payload example:
```
POST https://hooks.internal/pilot-survey/solaris
{
  "q1": "Was the enablement useful? (yes/no)",
  "q2": "Any SSO or provisioning issues? (yes/no)",
  "q3": "Integration blocker? (short text)",
  "q4": "Would you like a technical deep-dive? (yes/no)",
  "q5": "Would you recommend Redwood? (1-5)"
}
```
Aisha Khan: Perfect. Action items: Tom 1 re-check post-session for SSO flakiness, Nora 1 capture notes and tag renewal-risk if needed, Sam 1 monitor survey and trigger follow-up when "integration blocker" non-empty. I'll collate into the pilot board after the session.
Nora Patel: Will also capture a thumbs up/down and a 1-line win statement during the call.
Tom Li: All set from infra side. No other blockers.
Aisha Khan: Thanks team :team-heart: marking this thread ready. Re-open if Solaris raises procurement or legal concerns after receiving sanitized payload.
pilot-bot: Thread will auto-archive to pilot-solairs after 48h of inactivity.
